protocol.stage: post-reveal named-boundary interpretation; not a new scale preregistration
protocol.fixed_readout: Delta2=min_(a,b) E[(C^2-a*C-b)^2]/Var(C)^2=det(H2(C))/Var(C)^3, evaluated on the already stored positive center measure
protocol.boundary: Gaussian plus at most two distinct positive centers in the finite, nonzero-variance closure of the degree-six maximal-Gaussian representation. Affine-coordinate invariant, not invariant under arbitrary nonlinear thermal warps.
protocol.reported_explanatory_identity: Delta2=w_early*L_early; L_early is the exact ratio Delta2/w_early, describing compensating center leverage, not a second optimized distance
protocol.uncertainty: Apply this single algebraic readout to stored N100/N400/N900 common-batch LOO parameter vectors; no refitting of Gaussian variance or atoms. Retain covariance with early weight and its leverage ratio. Cross-size blocks are independent; consecutive increments share the middle source.
protocol.comparison_scope: Read ddf7d564 for the broader arbitrary common-symmetric-kernel two-lobe no-go. It is not the same boundary: a three-atom Gaussian mixture can itself factor as two translates of a non-Gaussian symmetric kernel.
